user.title: New safe filter
user.description: Clean up and smooth one sensor, or combine several sensors into one trustworthy value.

single.title: Filter one sensor
single.description: Turn one sensor into a trustworthy, smoothed value. Readings that are unavailable, stale or out of range are ignored, and the last good value is held for a while instead.

combine.title: Combine several sensors
combine.description: Combine several sensors into one trustworthy value. Sources that are unavailable, stale, out of range or disagree with the others are left out automatically.

data_description.entity_ids: Sensors to combine. Drag to reorder: with the Priority method, the first valid sensor is used.
data_description.method: How the valid sources are combined into one value.

weights.title: Weights
weights.description:
Give each source a relative weight. A source with weight 2 counts twice as much as one with weight 1. Weights are renormalised over the sources that are valid at any moment.

{sources}

quality.title: Data quality
quality.description: Rules that decide whether a source can be trusted. Values are in {unit}.

data.max_deviation: Max deviation from the other sources

data_description.min_value: Readings below this are ignored. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.max_value: Readings above this are ignored. Leave empty for no limit.
data_description.stale_after: A source that has not reported for this long is ignored. This catches dead devices that keep their last value. 0 turns the check off.
data_description.max_deviation: With 3 or more valid sources, a source further than this from the median of all of them is ignored. Leave empty to turn off.
data_description.min_sources: How many sources must be valid to compute a new value.
data_description.hold_time: When there is no valid reading (or too few valid sources), keep showing the last good value this long, then become unavailable. Also covers restarts.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional filters, applied in this order to the source value (or the combined value). Values are in {unit}. Each smoother adds delay, so usually one of low-pass or moving average is enough.

data_description.precision: Rounding is applied to the final value only.

data_description.window_size: Number of recent samples to compare against.
data_description.radius: A sample further than this from the median of the window is ignored. A real, lasting change is accepted after about half the window.

data_description.max_rate: The value may not change faster than this, in the sensor's unit per minute.

data_description.time_constant: Time-based exponential smoothing. After one time constant the output has moved about 63% of the way to a new level, no matter how often the sources report.

error.no_sources: Select at least one source sensor.
error.duplicate_sources: The same sensor is selected more than once.
error.incompatible_units: The selected sensors have units that cannot be converted to each other.
error.min_not_below_max: The lowest plausible value must be lower than the highest.
error.min_sources_too_high: Minimum valid sources can't be higher than the number of selected sensors.
error.max_rate_not_positive: Max change per minute must be greater than 0.
